ideas.title: Following the Money in the Minnesota Daycare Scandal
ideas.description: Investigate the use of federal funds in the Minnesota daycare scandal and the impact of the federal funding freeze
questions: How were federal funds used in the Minnesota daycare scandal?
What is the impact of the federal funding freeze?
ideas.insight: This story idea requires a deep dive into the financial records and transactions related to the Minnesota daycare scandal. By following the money, we can uncover potential patterns of fraud and abuse.
